issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'Test Entry Alpha' appeared immediately (count went 5->6), but after reloading http://localhost:6074/ the entry count reverted to 5 and the new entry was gone. The newly added 'Notes' field was also lost.
evidence: Post-reload semantic_snapshot shows statusbar.count '5 entries' and entries.table items list only the original 5 entries, no 'Notes' column.
Added 'Notes' field (Text type) via Fields dialog; it appeared as a column in table view, as a card field in card view, and as a text input in the Add Entry form.

Fields dialog type select shows clearly labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Add Entry form rendered type-appropriate native controls: input type=number for Priority, input type=date for Due Date, toggle checkbox for Completed, text input for Task Name/Notes.

Table view shows check icon (text-success class) for checked vs x icon (text-muted-foreground) for unchecked. Card view shows textual 'Yes'/'No'. Entry form toggle shows 'No'/'Yes' label that updates on click.

Entered text 'Beta Task', number 42, date 2026-12-25, checkbox checked, and text 'Beta notes' for Notes field. Values persisted identically in both card view (Beta Task/42/Dec 25, 2026/Yes/Beta notes) and table view (Beta Task/42/Dec 25, 2026/Beta notes) after saving.
Switched from cards to table view (and vice versa); entry count remained 6 and all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) were identical across both views, no data changed.
All 6 entries and all field values shown consistently in both table and card views. Empty Notes values rendered as '—' placeholder in both views, providing a clear empty-value representation.

Table sorted by Priority ascending (1,1,2,2,3,42) then descending (42,3,2,2,1,1) via column header click. Card view independently sorted by Task Name ascending. Switching back to table retained Priority descending; switching to cards retained Task Name ascending.

Selecting 'Priority' from Sort menu immediately reordered entries and statusbar showed 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'; clicking header again showed 'Sorted by Priority (descending)' with reversed order. App remained fully usable (other controls responsive) after sorting.

Across ascending/descending Priority sorts and Task Name sort, entry count remained 6 throughout and each entry's field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) were unchanged, only row order changed.

With no sort active, dragged (via keyboard sortable interaction) 'Design new landing page' row from position 1 to 3 in table view; order changed to Review, Update API, Design, Prepare, Team sync, Beta Task. In card view (separately, no sort), dragged 'Beta Task' card from last position to position 2. Switching back to table view retained the table's own manual order (Review, Update API, Design, Prepare, Team sync, Beta Task), unaffected by the card view reorder, confirming independent manual order per view.

issue: No filter feature exists in the UI
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, table headers, and DOM (all data-semtag-id attributes and all button labels) for a filter control; only Fields, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, Add Entry, and Search were found. No UI element allows defining field-specific filter criteria or restricting displayed entries to matching criteria (separate from quick search).
evidence: DOM scan of all [data-semtag-id] elements and all buttons found no filter control; no 'filter' text/class anywhere in body HTML.

issue: No filter feature exists to test criteria matching
actual: No filter UI is present anywhere in the app (verified via DOM scan), so field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined, and therefore filtering behavior (matching entries, restoring all on clear) cannot be exercised.

evidence: Searching 'beta' matched 'Beta Task' (count: '1 entry matching \"beta\"'). Searching uppercase 'REVIEW' matched 'Review marketing materials' case-insensitively (count: '1 entry matching \"REVIEW\"'). Clicking clear-search restored all 6 entries.

issue: Search matches internal raw values instead of formatted displayed values
actual: Searching displayed date text 'Jan 18' returned 0 results ('0 entries matching \"Jan 18\"') even though the table clearly shows 'Jan 18, 2026' for that entry. The same entry WAS found when searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-18'. Searching the displayed checkbox state 'Yes' (shown in card view and used for Completed) returned 0 results despite two entries showing 'Yes'.
evidence: statusbar.count sequence: 'Jan 18' -> 0 entries; '2026-01-18' -> 1 entry (Review marketing materials); 'Yes' -> 0 entries.

Priority field is a native input[type=number]. Attempting to type non-numeric text 'abc' into it was rejected outright by the browser ('Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), leaving the value unchanged at its numeric default (0). The saved entry retained Priority=0, a valid number; no non-numeric value could be entered or saved.

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Attempting to fill an invalid date '2026-13-45' was rejected by the browser ('Malformed value'), clearing the field rather than accepting the invalid string. Saving the entry with the cleared field resulted in a valid fallback date (Aug 26, 2026, today's date) being stored, not an invalid value.

issue: No data import feature exists in the app
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, main view, and Fields Configuration dialog (including full DOM/body HTML) for an import control or file upload. Only a static note text 'Configure fields before importing data' exists in the Fields dialog, but no actual button, file input, or UI flow to import data was found anywhere in the app.
evidence: DOM scan for 'import' keyword found only the static help text in the Fields dialog paragraph; no import button/input element exists.
